fullBodyContact.method: All four complete canvas PNGs displayed side by side at uniform 50 percent scale on an alpha-composited gray background; no content retouching.

observations.finding: The generated face is visibly cleaner than the same-camera lit result; obvious facial bands in the lit view are absent.
The face remains recognizable, with frayed or striped rear hair and visible rear-limb/occlusion seams.
A visible chin/neck band and rear-leg slices remain. Natural full-body rotation is not achieved.
Decoded frames show a real right-and-left orbit and return toward the front. The static captures and decoded frame contact were visually inspected.

interpretation.productIntegration: Pass: actual Factory perspective mode, RGB/lit switch and pointer-driven orbit operate without browser errors using the frozen final preset.
interpretation.visualGoal: Partial: front-face preservation improves; natural full-body rotation remains unmet.
interpretation.angularScope: The +/-30 degree orthographic head-comparison benefit is not a guarantee for full-body perspective. Here +/-30 labels are nominal OrbitControls drag angles; actual camera matrices were not available.
interpretation.causalLimit: Residual view, source and shape alignment artifacts are observed. This qualitative smoke does not uniquely attribute them to depth geometry, source RGB consistency or color selection.
interpretation.lighting: RGB mode adds no relighting. The selected hybrid still uses captured normals as view-color confidence.
interpretation.performance: This is a qualitative software-GPU UI capture. The requested 20 fps canvas stream is not evidence of sustained 20 fps rendering.

video.reviewMethod: All frames decoded with PyAV; nine timestamped decoded frames visually inspected. No claim of real-time playback performance.

nextAction: Keep RGB parallax opt-in and preserve the observed limitations. No additional shader trial is implied by this record.
